summary: Sila Realty Trust filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder litigation related to its planned merger with Sunshine Ultimate Parent LLC, which will take the company private. The merger agreement was entered on April 19, 2026, with a special meeting set for June 26, 2026. Two individual complaints and fifteen demand letters allege disclosure deficiencies in the proxy statement. The board recommends approval; no advisors named. The litigation seeks to enjoin the merger unless additional disclosures are made. Key watch: whether supplemental disclosures are issued or merger delayed; stockholder vote outcome and potential settlement/expedited resolution.
